snippet.title: Guard Break - Demo Trailer #jrpg
snippet.description:
Get the demo on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3324590/Guard_Break/
Website: https://guardbreakgame.com

Guard Break is a story-focused JRPG about elite agents, political intrigue, and a stolen superweapon. Build bonds, exploit enemy weaknesses, and lead an ensemble cast through fast turn-based battles as Arcadia spirals toward war. 

#jrpg #indiegame #retrogaming
